messages:
mike: Opening incident — observed rapid GPU node churn in cloud-west-2. Pool capacity dropped ~60% in 6m, queueing and 502/503s. Opening bridge.
julia: seeing high pod evictions and scheduler retries, autoscaler is oscillating. grabbing logs.
sre-bot: ALERT: gpu_pool_health cloud-west-2 < 70% (nodesDown=24, totalNodes=40) — triggered at 22:01:03 UTC
alisha: support seeing spike in error rates from customers in NA. 12 tickets flagged, a few are product-critical.
support-liaison: Drafting status page and support banner now. Proposed text: "Investigating degraded GPU capacity in cloud-west-2 affecting inference latency and transient 5xx. Traffic steering to alternate regions in progress. ETA 90 minutes." Link to draft: https://redwood.status/incident/2249991111-draft
oncall-eng: Initiated traffic shift for best-effort routes to cloud-west-3 and sfo-edge. Pausing non-reserved batch jobs. Starting canary in 1m.
ops-manager: cost implications — cross-region egress and bursting to spare pools will raise spend. Approve overruns for incident window?
karen: approve temporary budget increase, prioritize customer impact. keep detailed tracking for billing and postmortem. :thumbsup:
mike: cordoned 8 nodes manually, draining in-progress jobs. sample drain cmd: ```kubectl drain gpu-node-045 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```
julia: root cause signals -> peering control-plane flapped and triggered mass instance terminations in the pool, autoscaler reacted poorly (no backoff). Collecting ASG and cloud logs now.
sre-bot: NOTE: fallback routing rules applied for routes tagged "latency-sensitive" -> cloud-west-3 at 22:09:18 UTC
support-liaison: Contacting top 5 affected customers now, templated note ready. Will escalate any legal/SLA threats to CSM.
oncall-eng: After canary, latency for critical routes looks stable in cloud-west-3, moving 40% of traffic. Continuing slow-stepped migration.
ops-manager: please add a metric for migration egress and projected extra GPU-hours to the incident doc. Need rough estimate by +30m.
alisha: support queue reduced to 6 after banner. Two customers requested direct L2 bridge. Routing them to dedicated support.
mike: applying temporary autoscaler config: increase scaleDownDelay to 10m and add termination backoff. pushing as hotfix to cloud-west-2 now.
julia: hotfix applied (PR #4321) — autoscaler backoff in place. Monitoring for stability.
sre-bot: RECOVERY SIGNAL: gpu_pool_health cloud-west-2 rising to 85% at 22:24:50 UTC.
support-liaison: Status update posted: "Partial recovery: capacity returning, traffic steering continues. Remaining impact: degraded latency for some routes. ETA to full recovery 45-90 minutes. Customers with reserved capacity receiving direct updates." Link: https://redwood.status/incident/2249991111
karen: good work. Capture timeline and cost delta for postmortem. Let's keep incident bridge open until stable for 2 hours.
mike: continuing node stabilization and rolling restarts. will update if any regression.
ops-manager: noted — flag for billing reconciliation.
sre-bot: incident bridge closed by mike at 22:39:15 UTC for handoff to follow-up tasks. final note: monitoring for 2h.
